title: Austin: New Treasurer, Infrastructure, Events
summary:
*   **New City Treasurer Appointed:** Chester Thrasher was elected City Treasurer after a competitive bidding process, offering the highest interest rate (3.51%) on daily city fund balances. His substantial $300,000 bond was subsequently approved.
*   **Infrastructure Improvements & Maintenance:** The city approved funding for new electric lines to meet increasing power demands in east Austin and officially accepted the completed paving of Lavacca Street from 13th to 19th streets.
*   **Event Permits and Business Engagement:** The Retail Merchants Association received permission for temporary signs, electric lights, and fencing on 5th Street for an upcoming exposition. The council also began reviewing Quality Mills' proposal to use waste water from the city power plant for a nominal annual fee.
*   **Unique Property & Resident Actions:** An unused alleyway easement, originally established in 1896, was officially closed and returned to private ownership. Separately, a resident successfully petitioned for a $5.25 refund for a water meter, due to price reductions since his original purchase years prior.

Bids for City
Treasurer

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Whereas, in response to an
advertisement of the Supt of Receipts, Disbursements and Accounts, of bids for the Office
of City Treasurerand custodianship of the City's funds for the two years next after this
date, the following individuals of this City have this day submitted bids for the Office
of said City Treasurer and custodianship of the City's funds , to wit: H A Wroe, Vice
President, agreed to pay 3 1/10 per cent on daily balances.
W H Holts , Vice President, agreed to pay 3 30/100 per cent on daily balances.
Chester Thrasher, Vice President, agreed to pay 3 51/100 per cent on daily balances, and
each of said bidders offered to secure said deposits with good and sufficient bonds; and,
Whereas, it appears that Chester Thrasher, Vice President, is the highest and best bidder
for the Office of City Treasurer of the City of Austin for the next succeeding two years;
Now Therefore,
Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin : That the said Chester Thrasher,
Vice President, be and he is hereby elected City Treasurer of the City of Austin for the
two years next succeeding the date hereof , and as much, is entitled to the custody of the
City's funds; provided that he shall offer to the City Council and the City Council shall
approve his two certain bonds for the safekeeping and proper accounting for of said funds,
to-wit: one bond in the amount of OnehHundred thousand dollars with some approved Surety
Company as surety ,and another bond in the amount of two hundred thousand dollars with
good and sufficient personal sureties as sureties therefor.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.
